answer: Three words, three keepers: the ivory belongs to the toy shop, the glacier to the paint pot, the velvet to the nursery — and the farm has visited none of them. The strongest wall I know is Bin keeper golden sauternes warrant racked in the bin room, and it is built out of each golden sauternes is a cask count weighed beside the makers mark. A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own. Curing a proof takes 8 days, and a farm holding 471 proofs cannot cure them side by side.
